title: Adaptive Correlation Superclustering (ACSC) — acsc
text: ACSC builds feature-neighbor edges declared correlation metric unions six-neighbor block-grid edges. Edge correlations mapped non-negative Louvain similarities (correlation + 1) / 2. alpha = 0, feature-neighbor selection bypassed entirely, graph topology weights depend spatial adjacency. Optional DCT random projection changes feature-neighbor candidate selection, edge weights always recomputed using declared metric. Louvain calls use fixed internal seed restore caller's RNG state, identical ACSC inputs produce partition independently surrounding random stream. Boundary refinement uses metric representation graph building. Pearson uses centered unit vectors, Spearman uses centered average ranks, robust mode uses median-centered Tukey-bisquare residuals. C++ path accelerates centroid dot products recomputes active boundary every synchronous pass; failures fall back equivalent R path. refinement, labels flood-filled connected components. title: Randomize Cluster IDs — randomize_cluster_ids
text: Many clustering algorithms assign cluster IDs sequentially clusters encountered processing. voxels processed memory order (typically z-major 3D arrays), creates systematic ordering cluster ID correlates z-position (inferior superior brain imaging). spatial ordering creates two problems: Visualization artifacts: viewed continuous color scales (e.g., viridis, rainbow), ordered cluster IDs create artificial gradients suggest spatial structure none exists.
